name: comp-drift -- first-class estate drift compiler owning the local->git->cloud->nessie->kuzu->iceberg->trino->served propagation topology + per-hop parity
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-29 (live MSTR design session; brief docs/briefs/nfra-compdrift-brief-20260629.md, LD-0221). Drift detection is scattered as side-functions across ~10 tools with NO owner of the chain (symptom = the CTO naming-disambiguation arch-gate 2026-06-29 that stopped 3 'parity' concepts conflating). comp-drift = a FIRST-CLASS tool that OWNS a declared propagation topology + enforces the invariant that each hop is in parity with the stage before it; the existing seam-checkers become ENGINES it CALLS (NEVER re-implemented). The new first-class artifact = the topology manifest (org/modules/graph/drift-topology.yaml) + coverage ledger + a normalized cross-seam drift-record with a tri-state exit (adopted wholesale from the comp-lambdamap parity contract: 0 clean / 1 break / 2 UNVERIFIABLE, never-silently-MATCH). 5 CTO arch-gates ruled in the PRD: (a) manifest schema+location, (b) orchestrator-never-reimplement boundary, (c) normalized-record + tri-state CI contract, (d) Trino FAN-IN model (a node with N inbound catalog seams; git-code-heat = live-read HEAD-check special case), (e) the heat-federation cross-dependency AC. TIME-CRITICAL leverage: seam-6/seam-7 (Trino/Iceberg) depend on the LIVE NFRA_GLOBGRPH heat-federation build -- 'every federated catalog emits a checkable parity signal' threaded as an AC on that build BEFORE materialization (coordinated w/ 0.8.0_AE 2026-06-29 -- the one-time design-in window vs another scattered retrofit).
